LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.batch_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(latest.result = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, SUM(latest.result = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, SUM(latest.result IS NOT NULL) AS processed_count FROM settlement_item latest INNER JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, exchange_id, MAX(item_id) AS latest_item_id FROM settlement_item GROUP BY batch_id, exchange_id ) newest ON newest.latest_item_id = latest.item_id GROUP BY latest.batch_id ) stats ON stats.batch_id = sb.batch_id

mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_batch SET status = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_item latest WHERE latest.batch_id = #{batchId} AND latest.result = 'FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item newer WHERE newer.batch_id = latest.batch_id AND newer.exchange_id = latest.exchange_id AND newer.item_id > latest.item_id ) ) = 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, failure_message = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_item latest WHERE latest.batch_id = #{batchId} AND latest.result = 'FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item newer WHERE newer.batch_id = latest.batch_id AND newer.exchange_id = latest.exchange_id AND newer.item_id > latest.item_id ) ) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE '정산 Item 재처리 실패 건 존재' END WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE settlement_batch SET status = 'RUNNING', failure_message = NULL, run_id = COALESCE(#{runId}, run_id) WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'FAILED'
